verdicts.reason: Both candidates look the same. In each, the NEW badge has shrunk to an illegible pill, and the product can is a tiny thumbnail jammed between the badge and the Try It button, which crowds into the can from below. The supporting copy breaks into a cramped three-line block ending on the orphan 'now.', and the right-hand cluster is crowded while the headline sits alone on the left, so the layout reads as scattered fragments rather than an intentional banner. Neither has a visible flaw the other lacks.
